```python
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit, QuantumRegister, ClassicalRegister

# Create quantum and classical registers
q = QuantumRegister(3)
c = ClassicalRegister(2)

# Create circuit
circuit = QuantumCircuit(q, c)

# Initialize last qubit to |1>
circuit.x(q[2])

# Apply Hadamards to all qubits
circuit.h(q)

# Apply CNOTs from first two qubits into the last
circuit.cx(q[0], q[2])
circuit.cx(q[1], q[2])

# Apply another Hadamard layer
circuit.h(q[:2])

# Measure only the first two qubits
circuit.measure(q[0], c[0])
circuit.measure(q[1], c[1])

print(circuit.draw())
```

```python
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit, QuantumRegister, ClassicalRegister
import math

qc = QuantumCircuit(3, 3)

qc.h(0)  # Prepare qubit 0 in |+>
qc.barrier()

qc.h(2)  # Create Bell pair between qubits 1 and 2
qc.cx(2, 1)
qc.barrier()

qc.cx(0, 1)  # Teleportation step 1
qc.h(0)
qc.barrier()

qc.cx(1, 0)  # Teleportation step 2
qc.cz(2, 0)
qc.barrier()

qc.measure([0, 1], [0, 1])  # Measure qubits 0 and 1 into classical bits 0 and 1

qc.cx(1, 2)  # Apply CX from qubit 1 to 2
qc.cz(0, 2)  # Apply CZ from qubit 0 to 2
qc.barrier()

qc.measure(2, 2)  # Measure qubit 2 into classical bit 2
```

```python
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit, QuantumRegister, ClassicalRegister

def bernstein_vazirani_setup(n):
    qr = QuantumRegister(n+1)
    cr = ClassicalRegister(n)

    circuit = QuantumCircuit(qr, cr)
    circuit.h(qr[0:n])
    circuit.x(qr[n])
    circuit.h(qr[n])
    circuit.barrier()
    return circuit

# Example usage:
n = 3
circuit = bernstein_vazirani_setup(n)
print(circuit.draw())
```

```python
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit, QuantumRegister, ClassicalRegister

qc = QuantumCircuit(3, 3)

# Initialize q0 with X
qc.x(0)

# Create a Bell pair on q1 and q2 with H and CX
qc.h(1)
qc.barrier()
qc.cx(1, 2)

# Apply Alice’s CX(q0,q1) and H(q0)
qc.barrier()
qc.cx(0, 1)
qc.h(0)

# Measure q0 and q1 into c0 and c1
qc.barrier()
qc.measure([0, 1], [0, 1])

# Apply CX(q1,q2) and CZ(q0,q2)
qc.cx(1, 2)
qc.cz(0, 2)

# Measure q2 into c2
qc.barrier()
qc.measure(2, 2)
```

```python
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit, QuantumRegister, ClassicalRegister

# Create quantum and classical registers
qr = QuantumRegister(5)
cr = ClassicalRegister(4)

# Create circuit
circuit = QuantumCircuit(qr, cr)

# Prepare ancilla in |1>
circuit.x(qr[4])

# Apply Hadamards to all qubits
for q in qr:
    circuit.h(q)

# Implement balanced oracle with CNOT from fourth input qubit to ancilla
circuit.cx(qr[3], qr[4])

# Apply Hadamards to the four input qubits

# Measure four input qubits into classical bits
```

```python
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit, QuantumRegister, ClassicalRegister

# Create quantum and classical registers
q = QuantumRegister(3)
c = ClassicalRegister(3)

# Create quantum circuit
teleport = QuantumCircuit(q, c)

# Create Bell pair on qubits 1 and 2
teleport.h(q[1])
teleport.cx(q[1], q[2])

# Put qubit 0 into a Hadamard state
teleport.h(q[0])

# Perform Bell-basis steps on qubits 0 and 1
teleport.cx(q[0], q[1])
teleport.h(q[0])

# Measure qubits 0 and 1 into classical bits 0 and 1
teleport.measure(q[0], c[0])
teleport.measure(q[1], c[1])

# Apply CX from qubit 1 to 2 and CZ from qubit 0 to 2
teleport.cx(q[1], q[2])
teleport.cz(q[0], q[2])

# Measure qubit 2 into classical bit 2
teleport.measure(q[2], c[2])

print(teleport.draw(output='text'))
```
